summary.text: Reginald Murdock was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 9, which includes Crittenden and Phillips counties and parts of Lee and St. Francis counties.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 2011 through 2022.
A graduate of Lee High School in Marianna, he earned a degree in industrial engineering from the University of Arkansas and is an engineer and contractor.

sources.title: Biography of The Honorable Reginald Murdock, Arkansas State Senator
